brief.headline: Russia touts fuel-strike campaign as Crimea reels from Ukrainian attacks
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels celebrated an intensified campaign against Ukrainian gas stations and fuel logistics while grappling with a sharp mood downturn over Ukrainian drone strikes on Crimea that killed civilians and caused energy shortages.

developments.title: Channels tout escalating strikes on Ukrainian fuel network
developments.body: Multiple channels claimed Russian Geran/Geranium drones are now systematically hitting Ukrainian gas stations, fuel trucks and depots rather than depleted refineries, with Rybar asserting the pace exceeds April-May levels. Claims are channel-sourced and unverified; framed as a coordinated anti-logistics campaign amid a Ukrainian fuel crisis.

developments.title: Ukrainian strikes on Crimea drive sharp mood downturn
developments.body: Channels reported a child and adult killed near Dzhankoy, emergency power restrictions in Sevastopol, water shortages and reduced rail service; Arkhangel Spetsnaza cited 514 drones downed in 24 hours (MoD-adjacent, unconfirmed). Sentiment on this topic swung 43 points negative despite Russia's own strike gains.

developments.title: Konstantinovka push framed as gateway to Kramatorsk
developments.body: Kotsnews and WarGonzo claimed Russian forces are penetrating the 'fortress city' of Konstantinovka, cutting garrison supply lines, citing a Telegraph report that NATO fears Moscow aims at Kramatorsk and Slavyansk. Advances in Orikhiv and Zaporizhzhia directions also claimed; all unconfirmed.

developments.title: Rare self-criticism over refinery defense failures
developments.body: Two Majors demanded private refinery owners lose assets over inadequate wartime protection and blamed outdated 2014 laws and a May 2024 decree making fire-safety standards voluntary; Starshe Eddy criticized weak air defense specialists and passive protection. Criticism topic net sentiment was -100.

developments.title: Western tanker seizures condemned as 'piracy'
developments.body: Channels reported France detained the tanker Deliver off Sicily following a British seizure, and that Britain plans to sell seized Russian oil to fund Ukraine. Russia's embassy condemned the moves as maritime-law violations; framed as Western escalation against the shadow fleet.

developments.title: Rubio denial of Anchorage deal amplified as proof talks dead
developments.body: Starshe Eddy and Poddubny highlighted US Secretary of State Rubio denying any formal Russia-Ukraine agreement existed from Anchorage, reinforcing channel messaging that negotiations are futile and the war will be prolonged.

narrative_watch.title: Negotiations are futile, war will be prolonged
narrative_watch.body: Two Majors argues the enemy will only negotiate from a defeated position, pairing with amplification of Rubio's Anchorage denial to preempt any peace-process optimism.

narrative_watch.title: Apple app removal as 'digital bombing'
narrative_watch.body: Rybar and Kotsnews frame Apple pulling VK and other Russian apps from the AppStore as an infrastructure attack comparable to a bombing campaign, escalating tech-sanctions grievance rhetoric.

narrative_watch.title: Keeping Belarus out of the war
narrative_watch.body: Channels amplify Lukashenko warning Zelensky against dragging Belarus into conflict and portray Belarus opening borders to Ukrainian refugees as embarrassing Kyiv.

mood_lines.text: Buoyant; channels celebrate expanded anti-fuel and deep-strike campaign hitting gas stations, depots, railways and substations across multiple regions.
Confident on claimed Konstantinovka and Zaporizhzhia advances, Lancet tank kills and drone interdiction; net sentiment strongly positive.
Sharp downturn; Crimea civilian deaths, energy and fuel shortages dominate despite claims of hundreds of drones intercepted.
Hostile; EU aid tranches, tanker seizures and denied negotiations framed as escalation and piracy against Russia.
Mixed; FSB arrest and Yak-130M flight boost mood, offset by fuel shortages, Apple app removal and refinery-defense complaints.
Uniformly negative; refinery protection failures, outdated laws, draft evaders and a boycotted Mariupol war film draw internal ire.

flag_texts.title: Crimea attacks flip sentiment on Ukrainian strikes
flag_texts.body: Net sentiment on Ukraine strikes on Russia moved 43 points to -27 as channels reported civilian deaths near Dzhankoy, Sevastopol power restrictions, water and fuel shortages and reduced rail service across the peninsula.

flag_texts.title: Mobilisation and Putin criticism absent
flag_texts.body: Watchlisted topics 'Mobilisation rumours' and 'Criticism of Putin' saw no posts today; internal criticism instead targeted refinery owners, bureaucracy and army command.
